response.query: What automated gradient checks (finite-difference, complex-step) and numerical tolerances will we run across representative circuits and frequency sweeps?
response.answer: Automated gradient checks using finite-difference and complex-step methods will be run across representative circuits with numerical tolerances set to ensure accuracy. Frequency sweeps will cover a range from low to high frequencies.
